notes.title: Widower's Sky - Update 2
notes.content:
Update 2:

Big thanks for the replies and suggestions. Been a busy first week! If you were lost, this update is for you. 

Check out the latest update notes below:

New tutorial
-Updated tutorial with more control explanations
-Clearer objectives

Mini Map
-See your objectives with the mini map, turn it off in the Main Menu for full immersion
 
New settings
-Aiming sensitivity slider in Main Menu
-Mini Map toggle
-Revised "Clear Progress" option

Bird Guides
-Call the birds to guide you in your travels. If they can, they will help.

Revised levels
-Slight level updates

Revised Dog Follow
-If your dog is far away, choose Follow in the dog menu to bring him close

Bug fixes
-Carry sound volume on new level
-Cursor hides when using controller
-Aim camera sensitivity
-Tutorial fixes
-Refined controls
-Aiming is now default when equipping bow and arrow
-Re-balanced Audio

Performance optimizations

More soon!

Thanks,
Mike

notes.title: Widower's Sky: Update 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33235376/05a360aef6e3d063654977b35a2830a15bf9e096.png[/img]

Update 1:

Thanks for the great feedback. Happy to take the great ideas/suggestions to update Widower's Sky!

First updates to Widower's Sky here:

[list]
[*] Small revisions to the tutorial (more to come)
[*] Changed default settings when using bow and arrow. Aiming is now default
[*] Information regarding hub level
[*] Running is now the default state
[*] Carrying the son is now default
[*] Revised Main Menu intro level
[*] Small fixes to first level
[*] Gameplay option for survival or casual mode on initial setup (see main menu settings to toggle survival mode)
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Performance optimization
[/list]

Much larger updates coming soon!

Thanks,
Mike
